findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Finset/Max.lean:277 `theorem exists_next_right {x : α} {s : Finset α} (h : ∃ y ∈ s, x < y) : ∃ y ∈ s, x < y ∧ ∀ z ∈ s, x < z → y ≤ z`; already used elsewhere in the repo (TauCeti/FieldTheory/RealClosure/AbstractRolle.lean:104).
findings.fix: Replace the induction with: case split on `∃ y ∈ S, r < y`; in the positive case `obtain ⟨y, hyS, hry, hy⟩ := Finset.exists_next_right h`, take `c` from `exists_between (lt_min hry hrb)`, then `hy x hx hrx : y ≤ x` gives `c < x`; in the negative case take `c` from `exists_between hrb`.
findings.issue: `exists_right_gap` re-derives, by a hand-rolled `Finset.induction_on`, exactly the content of `Finset.exists_next_right`, which lives in `Mathlib/Data/Finset/Max.lean:277` — a module this file already imports (`public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Max`).

findings.evidence: SignedRemainders.lean:29-30 `Remainder p q r := ∃ a b u, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ C a * p = u * q - C b * r` vs SturmTarski.lean:32-33 `TarskiSeed p f q := ∃ a b u, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ C a * (f * p.derivative) = u * p + C b * q`.
findings.fix: Define `def TarskiSeed (p f q) : Prop := Remainder (f * p.derivative) p (-q)` and delete `TarskiSeed.of_identity`/`TarskiSeed.exists_identity`, using `Remainder.of_identity`/`Remainder.exists_identity` (closing the sign with `sub_neg_eq_add`) in `mul_derivative`, `mod`, `sign` and `zero`.
findings.issue: `TarskiSeed p f q` is the `Remainder` relation of SignedRemainders.lean:29 with permuted arguments: `TarskiSeed p f q ↔ Remainder (f * p.derivative) p (-q)` (unfold: `C a * (f * p') = u * p - C b * (-q)`, i.e. `= u * p + C b * q`). Consequently `TarskiSeed.of_identity`/`exists_identity` (lines 39, 46) are a parallel copy of `Remainder.of_identity`/`exists_identity` (SignedRemainders.lean:48, 54).

findings.evidence: Bodies are `tarski_zero hseed hsimple (p.roots.toFinset.filter …) … (a := a) (b := a)`; `mathlib/Mathlib/Data/List/SignVariations.lean:56 signVariations_singleton (a : α) : signVariations [a] = 0`; grep for the three names shows no uses outside their own definitions.
findings.fix: Delete the three corollaries; callers instantiate `tarski_zero` with `Z := p.roots.toFinset.filter (a < ·)` / `(· < b)` / `p.roots.toFinset`, exactly as the deleted proofs do.
findings.issue: `tarski_zero_Ioi` (165), `tarski_zero_Iio` (176) and `tarski_zero_univ` (187) are direct instances of `tarski_zero` (SturmTarski.lean:198), which already quantifies over an arbitrary `Z : Finset R` of roots and over arbitrary `a b`; each body is that instance plus a `simpa`. All four statements are `0 = 0`, since `variation [p] x = variationTop [p] = variationBot [p] = 0` by `List.signVariations_singleton`. They have no in-repo consumers.

findings.evidence: Identical text at PolynomialSigns.lean:37-40 and IVT.lean:61-64; the shared ingredient `Polynomial.natDegree_le_two_of_irreducible` is declared at TauCeti/FieldTheory/RealClosure/AlgebraicClosed.lean:84.
findings.fix: Add `theorem Polynomial.natDegree_eq_one_or_two_of_irreducible (hp : Irreducible p) : p.natDegree = 1 ∨ p.natDegree = 2` next to `natDegree_le_two_of_irreducible` in RealClosure/AlgebraicClosed.lean:84 and use it in both places.
findings.issue: The four-line derivation `have hdeg : q.natDegree = 1 ∨ q.natDegree = 2 := by have := q.natDegree_le_two_of_irreducible hq; have := hq.natDegree_pos; omega` is copied verbatim from TauCeti/FieldTheory/RealClosure/IVT.lean:61-64.

summary: The Sturm–Tarski development itself is new (Mathlib has only the algebraic `sturmSeq` file, and TauCeti had only `Sturm/GCD.lean`), and it reuses `List.signVariations`, `sturmSeq` and the real-closed IVT API correctly. But `Finset.exists_right_gap` re-proves an imported Mathlib lemma, `TarskiSeed` is a second copy of the `Remainder` relation with duplicated accessors, the three `tarski_zero_*` corollaries are one-line instances of `tarski_zero`, and an irreducible-degree step is cloned verbatim from `RealClosure/IVT.lean`.
